experiment_data.hypothesis: DDR pattern (drifting central-tendency, stationary shape features) persists at 14B+ scale: Qwen3-14B-Base generation chains exhibit similar ρ/d decomposition as sub-8B models, with drifting features |ρ|>0.4 and stationary features |d|<0.2, ruling out scale-dependent DDR collapse up to 14.7B parameters
experiment_data.notes: Qwen3-14B-Base (14.7B params, FP16 ~29GB). 单张 RTX 5090 推理。500 seeds × 5 depths, continuation prompt, t=0.7. 纯 feature analysis (ρ + d)，不训练分类器。模型下载中 (ModelScope/HF CLI, 目标路径 /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen3-14B-Base/)。生成用 generate_chain.py。

spec.command: python3 generate_chain.py --input data/wiki_seed_1000.jsonl --output-dir data/generations --model-name qwen3-14b-base --model-path /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen3-14B-Base --device cuda:0 --temperature 0.7 --top-p 0.9 --shard-id 0 --num-shards 2
